title: Time & Astronomy
description: Current time by timezone, astronomy events, and moon phases
summary: Current time by timezone, astronomy events, and moon phases
offersHint: Current time by timezone, astronomy events, and moon phases · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://time.memoryapi.org/mcp

toolsPreview.name: get_current_time
toolsPreview.description: Get the current time in any timezone. Returns local datetime, UTC datetime, unix epoch, UTC offset, DST status, day of week, day of year, and week number.

toolsPreview.name: get_astronomy
toolsPreview.description: Get sunrise, sunset, and twilight times for any location using US Naval Observatory data. Also returns moonrise and moonset.

toolsPreview.name: get_moon_phases
toolsPreview.description: Get upcoming moon phases (New Moon, First Quarter, Full Moon, Last Quarter) and current moon illumination percentage from the US Naval Observatory.
